verdict.rationale: Gitea's managed offering explicitly lets teams "Choose your provider and region". The product is also a self-hosted Git service offering "Full control", deployable on your own servers, so users decide where their data physically lives. missing for 10: a documented list of available managed regions, formal data-residency guarantees or policy docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Launch a managed environment for teams that want speed, support, and low operational overhead. Choose your provider and region
Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license. Full control, unlimited users and repositories.
or use container (docker/podman/etc) to deploy on your own server with the official image.
